subject: Mosaic Health post-audit capacity rectification plan and one-time settlement
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@mosaichealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Mosaic post-audit usage — preliminary findings and next steps

Samir,

Thanks again for walking us through the audit results this morning. We reviewed the usage logs and want to propose a path to reconcile the retroactive consumption you flagged for Q2–Q3. Summary attached (mosaic_postaudit_usage_summary.csv). High level: ~1.3M excess inference tokens attributed to bursty jobs tied to a new pipeline that spun up untagged workers.

Options we recommend so Mosaic can close the book quickly:
- One-time settlement: a single invoice for the excess usage at 60% of list unit price (proposed in attached PDF).
- Amortized credit: spread the charge as a one-time true-up divided over 3 monthly invoices with a 20% administrative credit.
- Usage guardrail: enable quota/burst controls and prefix-based caching to prevent recurrence (we'll provide config and a short runbook).

Ben and Laura are looped in to weigh in on price and contract implications. If these look reasonable we'll prepare a redline and a DocuSign packet for signature. Can you confirm Mosaic's preferred path by EOW (Friday)?

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: mosaic_postaudit_usage_summary.csv (CSV stub: 14 rows, per-day token counts, suspected untagged worker IDs)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@mosaichealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@mosaichealth.com, Legal - Mosaic <legal@mosaichealth.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mosaic post-audit usage — preliminary findings and next steps

Grace —

Appreciate the write-up and the options. Quick answers: Mosaic prefers amortization if the credit is material, and we need a short memo showing the activity that generated the spike (our finance team needs the audit trail). Can Ben or Laura provide the per-job attribution and the list of untagged worker IDs you flagged?

Also Legal will want a one-paragraph representation that this settlement closes prior claims for the relevant period.

Samir
VP Product, Mosaic Health

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@mosaichealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 18:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mosaic post-audit usage — preliminary findings and next steps

Samir —

We extracted the job-level attribution and attached a condensed export that maps worker IDs to request timestamps and token counts. You should see the same untagged worker IDs referenced in Grace's sheet. For the amortization approach, our typical procedure is a 3-month rollforward; we'll apply a 20% administrative credit if you choose that path.

I've also drafted the closing language for legal: "Upon receipt of payment (or completion of the agreed amortization schedule), Redwood Inference and Mosaic Health agree that this settlement resolves any claims arising from the listed usage period and shall not be used as precedent for prior or future disputes." Happy to adjust per your counsel.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: mosaic_job_attribution_export.csv (CSV stub: columns job_id, worker_id, start_ts, tokens)
From: Legal - Mosaic <legal@mosaichealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@mosaichealth.com>, procurement@mosaichealth.com
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 14:37:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mosaic post-audit usage — preliminary findings and next steps

Ben/Grace —

The draft closing paragraph looks fine conceptually. A few requests before sign-off:
1) Replace "receipt of payment" with "receipt of payment or completion of the agreed amortization schedule".
2) Add a reference to the usage export attachment as Exhibit A to be appended to the settlement.
3) Confirm that Redwood will not pursue collection beyond the agreed schedule if Mosaic complies in good faith.

If you can incorporate those three points into the settlement doc, we can circulate a final redline for internal Mosaic approval.

— Mosaic Legal

---
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Legal - Mosaic <legal@mosaichealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@mosaichealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, procurement@mosaichealth.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mosaic post-audit usage — preliminary findings and next steps

Thanks — incorporated and attached (proposed_settlement_terms.pdf). Key points: 1) settlement amount committed if amortized will be billed across 3 invoices (60/20/20 split), 2) administrative credit reflected, 3) Exhibit A points to the job-level export (we'll attach the CSV to the DocuSign packet), and 4) Redwood commits not to escalate collection activities provided Mosaic adheres to the schedule and engages in good faith.

I've also added a short implementation checklist: enable project-level tagging for your pipelines, apply the suggested prefix cache to high-volume endpoints, and we'll run a configuration review call after the first amortized invoice posts. Vivek — can your team own the implementation follow-up?

If Mosaic approves, I'll issue the DocuSign link with the attached exhibits. Target signature by Nov 10 to meet upcoming invoicing cycles.

Cheers,
Grace

---
Attachment: proposed_settlement_terms.pdf (PDF stub: 3 pages; settlement amount, amortization schedule, Exhibit A reference)
From: procurement@mosaichealth.com
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@mosaichealth.com>, Legal - Mosaic <legal@mosaichealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mosaic post-audit usage — preliminary findings and next steps

Grace / Ben —

Procurement confirms Mosaic will proceed with the amortized settlement. Please send the DocuSign packet. We expect the first amortized charge to appear on the Dec invoice and the remaining two on Jan and Feb invoices. Once we receive DocuSign we will process internally.

Regards,
Maya R. (on behalf of Procurement)
Mosaic Health
